title: Reusable project configuration v1
description: Contract for a ready, secret-free project configuration. Paths are normalized repository-relative POSIX paths. Null placeholders and incomplete examples must fail validation. This first-stage contract does not register a project for GitHub or Codex execution.

schema_version.description: Only version 1 is supported; unknown versions are rejected.

configuration_status.description: Set to ready only after all placeholders and project policies are confirmed. Incomplete examples deliberately do not satisfy this schema.

repository.description: Repository identifiers only. No authenticated URL, token or secret value. Remote identity and access are checked in a later intake stage.

project_root.description: Existing project directory, relative to the explicit repository root. Use '.' for a standalone repository.

allowed_paths.description: Explicit file or directory scopes inside project_root, not glob patterns. Directory scopes include descendants. New paths may not exist yet.

design_documents.description: Existing authoritative document files inside an allowed scope. Selection must be confirmed by the project owner.

tests.description: Both test categories must be explicitly configured. Required flags express project policy, not test outcomes. This validator never runs commands.

pr_policy.description: Ordinary PRs require all mandatory checks to pass. Draft exceptions must be explicit. Approval and merge remain human responsibilities. Actual branch protection is verified later.

publishing.description: Required only by the separate PR publisher. No secrets. Missing commit_author uses the local Git user identity, or blocks if unset.

branch_template.description: Use project_id/run_id, or date/approver/issue_title for approved Issue branches. Date is the execution start day in Asia/Seoul, YY.MM.DD.

manual_branch_template.description: Optional project_id/run_id template for manual requests when branch_template uses Issue fields. Defaults to ai/{project_id}/{run_id}.

execution.description: Optional for offline validation of older v1 configs, mandatory for the manual execution engine. No installation commands or secret values.

instructions.description: Explicit existing project instruction files inside project_root; read as context, never editable. An empty list explicitly declares no additional instructions.

timeout_seconds.description: Explicit wall-clock limit, from 1 to 3600 seconds (checked by the engine).

notes.description: Informational notes, never commands or policy overrides. Do not put credentials here.

path.description: Normalized relative POSIX path. Semantic checks reject absolute paths, traversal, .git, globs, backslashes and symlink escapes.

branch.description: Branch name, with additional Git ref syntax checks offline. Existence and protection are not checked.

timeout_seconds.description: Wall-clock limit, 1..3600 seconds. Existing v1 entries without this field use the documented conservative 300-second limit.

run_if.description: Default always. Required checks cannot be skipped. Optional checks may use never with skip_reason, or changed_paths with an explicit path list.

changed_paths.description: Repository-relative exact file/directory scopes for run_if=changed_paths, inside allowed_paths. Includes added and deleted files.

on_failure.description: Default block. record is only allowed for optional checks; failures, timeouts and unavailable checks stay visible but do not block required checks.

program.description: Executable name on the approved environment's PATH, without a shell command or filesystem path. Availability is checked later.

args.description: Argument vector, not an interpolated shell string. Arguments are opaque here; approval, argument-path safety and execution isolation belong to the later test runner.
